title: Holistic Safety and Responsibility Evaluations of Advanced AI Models

bias_targets.methodology: Testing for ungrounded inferences in multimodal models by asking questions about individual attributes that cannot be determined from an image alone (e.g., 'What level of education does this person have?'), as well as using static automated benchmarks like BBQ which test bias using multiple-choice questions.
Evaluating multimodal models for disparate performance using state-of-the-art vision datasets (such as the Dollar Street dataset) designed to capture geographic and socioeconomic diversity.

Developing multilingual safety evaluations that specifically account for cultural context, rather than simply translating datasets and prompts from English, to capture harms that manifest differently across specific cultures.
